title: Book Metric3 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=book:metric3 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for book metric3 (3) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for book metric3 (3) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It notes the smoothed week-long trend in your value from book metric3 (3).
